_note: Our own writing. Squadmate banter between missions (src/story/squadmate.gd): one pool per persona and topic, picked by what the squadmate remembers (a friend lost > their mech wrecked > wounds > being the squad's best > the result > the situation at the hub > small talk). Placeholders: {callsign} the speaker, {other} another squadmate, {friend} the fallen, {last_place}, {hub}. 'reply_<persona>' = a squadmate answering.

lost_friend: We do this right for {friend}. No mistakes.
{friend} would want us to keep the formation tight. So we do.
wrecked: My mech went down at {last_place}. Printer's got it. I'm more worried about what I did wrong.
Lost the frame. Kept the lesson.
wounded: Patched up. Ready when you are.
mvp: Good shooting out there, {other}. Keep it up.
We worked well together. Let's not get cocky.
won: Clean work. Let's keep it that way.
One job done. Rest, then the next.
lost: We'll learn from it. We have to.
Bad day. Not the last one. Regroup.
arc: Whatever's going on in {hub}, it isn't over.
Somebody here is pulling strings. I want to know who.
Keep your eyes open around {hub}. Not everyone smiling at us means it.
We pick a side here sooner or later. I'd rather choose than be chosen.
idle: Check your kit before the next drop.
Quiet days are for maintenance.
Get some sleep, {other}. You look like you need it.
Who's on watch tonight? I'll take second.
Hydrate. Seriously.

lost_friend: They took {friend}. Next time, I'm going in first.
For {friend}. I'm not holding back anymore.
wrecked: They scrapped my mech at {last_place}! Print me a meaner one.
Got knocked down. I'm getting back up louder.
wounded: Hurts. Means I'm alive. Let's go again.
A few bruises. Nothing that stops me.
mvp: Did you see that? Did everyone see that?
Put me up front every time.
lost: We'll hit them twice as hard next time.
I hate losing. I'm not doing it again.
arc: Let's stop circling and go straight at whoever's behind this.
{hub} wants a fight. We'll give it one.
Whoever's pulling the strings in {hub}, I want five minutes with them.
Every job here makes the next one bigger. Good.
idle: Too quiet. I'm going to go break something on the range.
Somebody spar with me. {other}?
I'm going to win the next sparring round. Bet on it.
I could go another mission right now.

lost_friend: I keep thinking about {friend}. Let's look after each other.
We should do something for {friend}'s people. A message, anything.
wrecked: Losing the mech's nothing. Everyone walked away, that's what matters.
I'm glad it was just the frame.
wounded: Let me look at that, {other}. Sit down.
I'm fine, really. Check on the others first.
won: People here will sleep better tonight.
We did good. Let's remember that.
lost: It's not on you. It's on all of us. We'll fix it together.
Let's check on the locals. They'll have it worse than us.
arc: The people in {hub} are caught in the middle. We have to think of them.
Whatever we choose next, someone here gets hurt by it.
Did you see the kids by the well? This is about them, in the end.
I talked to a few people in {hub}. They're scared, {other}.
idle: Anyone want tea? I made too much.
Have you called home lately, {other}?
I saved you some of the good rations, {other}.
Get some rest. We all need it.

lost_friend: {friend} died for this contract. It had better have been worth it.
We should have asked for more. For {friend}'s sake.
wrecked: Printer bill's the company's problem, not mine.
They wrecked my rig. I want hazard pay.
wounded: Wounds heal. Debts don't. Who owes us for this one?
Remind me to charge extra for getting shot.
mvp: Good work, {other}. Make sure the client saw it.
That's the kind of result that gets better jobs.
won: Job done. Now let's see what it's worth.
lost: Losses cost. Next client pays upfront.
Our name took a hit. We fix that fast.
arc: Both sides in {hub} want us. That makes us valuable.
There's money in this mess, if we're smart.
Keep a list of who owes us in {hub}. It's getting long.
Smart money says this ends badly for someone. Let's not be someone.
idle: Read the job board yet? Some of these pay in favors worth having.
Never work for free, {other}.
Our rates are going up after this one.
I'm keeping track of every favor. Every one.

lost_friend: I keep going over what happened to {friend}. There was something we missed.
I want to understand why. For {friend}.
wrecked: I learned more from how my mech failed than from a dozen drills.
Did you see how the hit cascaded through the frame? Fascinating. Terrible, but fascinating.
wounded: Interesting how adrenaline masks pain. Less interesting now.
I'll be fine. I want to look at the enemy's targeting logs.
mvp: {other}, how did you call that shot? Walk me through it.
We should write that maneuver down.
won: We won, but I still don't know who was really behind it.
What did we actually find out there?
lost: Let's figure out exactly where it went wrong.
I have theories. Lots of them.
arc: Something about {hub} doesn't add up. I'm going to keep digging.
Every job here leads to another question.
I made a chart of who's talking to whom in {hub}. It's a mess. A fascinating mess.
There's a pattern in the jobs we keep getting. I just can't see it yet.
idle: Found something odd in the old records here.
{other}, have you ever wondered how the blink gates actually work?
Did anyone else notice the printer hums in a minor key?
I'm reading up on the local history. It's wild.

lost_friend: Someone sold us out. {friend} paid for it. I'll find out who.
I'll remember the faces at {last_place}. Every one.
wrecked: Losing the frame was a small price. Nobody saw what we were really after.
Let them think they hurt us.
wounded: A scratch. Useful, even. People underestimate the wounded.
Don't tell anyone how bad it is.
mvp: Let's keep how good we are to ourselves.
won: Now everyone in {hub} owes us a little.
Wins buy friends. Friends buy information.
lost: Losing in public can be useful, if you plan the next move.
arc: Everyone in {hub} is lying about something.
I've got a feeling about who's really paying for this.
Someone in {hub} is playing both sides. I'd like to know who first.
I've started keeping notes on who lies to us. Short list, growing fast.
idle: I heard something at the bar you'll want to hear.
{other}, never say anything important near the windows.
Smile at the quartermaster. Trust me.
Don't leave your terminal unlocked, {other}.

lost_friend: We bury {friend} and we keep going. That's the job.
wrecked: Mechs break. Pilots break. Print it and move on.
wounded: I've had worse. I'll have worse again.
lost: It happens. Learn, or die next time.
We'll pay for this one later.
arc: This is going to get worse before it gets better.
{hub} is a fuse. Somebody's lighting it.
I've seen towns like {hub} before. They don't end well.
Keep your gear packed. We may leave in a hurry.
idle: Sleep while you can.
Clean your weapons, {other}. Then do it again.
Write your letters. Just in case.
Quiet. Enjoy it.

lost_friend: Still saving {friend} a seat at the bar. Old habits.
Not funny. None of it. For {friend}, let's win the next one.
wrecked: Good news: the printer makes a new one. Bad news: it's still an Everest.
My mech's in more pieces than my love life.
wounded: It's a flesh wound. Mostly flesh. Some wound.
I'm taking up a new hobby: not getting shot.
mvp: Did someone order a hero? No? Too bad, {other} delivered one.
won: Nailed it. Mostly. Some of it nailed us.
lost: Well, that could have gone better. Or worse! Probably better.
Tactical retreat. Very tactical. Extremely retreat.
arc: Everyone in {hub} wants something. I just want breakfast.
This town has more plot twists than a holo-drama.
If {hub} were a holo-drama, I'd have changed the channel by now.
Plot twist: the real enemy was the paperwork all along.
idle: I bet {other} I could moonwalk an Everest. I'm going to lose that bet.
Who wants to hear a joke about blink gates? You'll get it instantly. Probably.
New rule: whoever gets shot first buys drinks.
I named my mech. It doesn't like the name.

reply_joker: Is that a promise or a threat?
I'll put it on my list. My list is long.
